policy: A missing year is never treated as zero until its historical backfill has been reviewed and marked complete.

2023.notes: Primary TruckersMP Event API scan for event IDs 10000-19999 and dates 2023-07-09 through 2023-12-31 completed. Additional archived/internal sources may still add events.

2024.notes: Historical TruckersMP participation must be reconstructed from old event pages and Kings-owned archives.

2025.notes: Some hosted and external events are already verified, but the year is not yet assumed complete.

2026.notes: Current/future events are collected automatically; older external participation for the year still needs backfill.
